note: Goldens are measured on the card, so they are per hardware type (hw/<hardware>/), as is the Judge's hash manifest images/judge/protected_hashes/<hardware>.txt; scripts/build_images.sh picks this host's. judge/ and hw/<hardware>/judge/ go into the host-built Judge holdout layer. $SDV2_BUILD_ROOT is the task's build/ directory on the host that generated it and $SDV2_ASSETS_ROOT the staged asset root (scripts/stage_assets.py). Weights, the flash-attn wheel, the upstream smoke checkout and the public embeddings/clips (the Work and public Judge build inputs) still come from SDV2_ASSETS_ROOT and are added here in a later step.
